currentContext.business: An operational creditor filed for insolvency before the NCLT, Bengaluru in 2017; the application was admitted on 20 February 2018 with a moratorium from that date, a resolution plan was approved by order dated 10 May 2019, and the NCLT closed the IBC proceedings on 22 April 2022. Pursuant to the approved resolution plan and the NCLT orders, the company carried out a reduction of capital and issued new shares to M/s Vision Textile against funds infused by that entity, leaving M/s Vision Textile (Promoter) with 97.88% of the equity and public shareholding at 2.12%. The Board states that the company is being revived by the new management, that operations will start any time soon, and that the Management Discussion and Analysis segment will be provided from the current financial year onwards.

promoters.name: M/s Vision Textile
promoters.role: Promoter holding 97.88% of the equity (public shareholding 2.12%) after the capital reduction and fresh share issue made against funds it infused under the NCLT-approved resolution plan; leads the new management reviving the company's operations.

board.name: Abhay Mandhana
board.designation: Chairperson & Director (DIN: 07695839); appointed Additional Director w.e.f. September 18, 2025 and proposed at the 27th AGM for regularisation as Director liable to retire by rotation and to continue as Whole-time Director under Section 203

board.name: Himmatsingh Dasharathsingh Shekhawat
board.designation: Director (DIN: 02625197), liable to retire by rotation and seeking re-appointment at the 27th AGM

currentContext.strategies: Revive the company under the new management and restart operations, with segment-level MD&A disclosure to begin from the current financial year.|Run a dynamic, board-supported risk management framework under a formal risk management policy, with a mechanism to apprise the Board on risk assessment, minimisation procedures and periodic review.|No dividend was paid due to losses and no amount could be transferred to reserves during the year, though the Board has formulated and adopted a Dividend Distribution Policy under Regulation 43A of SEBI LODR; the AGM notice records no final dividend record or payment date. The company has issued no debt instruments and undertaken no fixed deposit programme or any scheme involving mobilisation of funds in India or abroad, so credit rating is not applicable for FY2025-26, and no loans, guarantees or investments were given during FY2025-26. Fresh equity was issued to M/s Vision Textile against funds infused under the NCLT-approved resolution plan, alongside a reduction of capital. There were no material changes or commitments affecting the financial position between the close of FY2025-26 and the date of the report; the term loan referred to by the auditors had been raised for investment in group projects and repayment of an unsecured loan, but as the group-project deployment was prolonged the idle funds were used for company operations and remitted as an advance for procurement of goods, a matter the Board says efforts are underway to close.
currentContext.expansion: The annual report discloses no capacity, capex or expansion project. The only forward-looking operational statement is that the company is being revived by the new management following the NCLT-approved resolution plan, that operations will start any time soon, and that the MD&A segment will be provided from the current financial year onwards. Under the resolution plan the company undertook a reduction of capital and issued new shares to M/s Vision Textile in consideration of funds infused by that entity, leaving the promoter with 97.88% of the equity and the public with 2.12%.
currentContext.mdna: No demand or outlook commentary is given: management states only that the company is being revived by the new management and that operations will start any time soon, with the MD&A segment to be provided from the current financial year onwards.

risks.risk: Company is not yet operational — revival is unproven
risks.note: Management says only that the company is being revived by the new management and that "operations of the company will start any time soon"; there is no operating business, and MD&A segment disclosure is deferred to the current financial year, so the restart timeline and its execution remain entirely unproven.

An operational creditor's IBC application was admitted by the NCLT, Bengaluru on 20 February 2018 with a moratorium; a resolution plan was approved on 10 May 2019 and proceedings closed on 22 April 2022. The company's entire capital structure and ownership rest on implementation of that plan.
During the moratorium the company was delisted by both BSE and NSE, so shareholders' ability to trade the stock depends on regulatory and exchange processes rather than on operating performance.

risks.risk: Extreme promoter concentration and minimal public float
risks.note: M/s Vision Textile (Promoter) holds 97.88% of the equity while public shareholding stands at 2.12%, following the capital reduction and fresh issue under the NCLT orders — leaving minority holders with negligible influence and negligible float.

risks.risk: Risk framework is policy-stage, with oversight concentrated in the Board and one committee
risks.note: The company states it has designed a risk management framework and formulated a risk management policy supported by the Board, management and the Committee, but no risks-and-concerns discussion or risk register is disclosed, so investors cannot yet see which operating risks are being tracked or how.
